provider_environment.description: Recorded at order-submission time from the credentials the adapter actually used. 'live' means real money; 'simulated' means a local stand-in answered; 'unknown' means Paari could not attribute the object and it must not be presented as a provider settlement.

provider_key_id_prefix.description: First characters of the provider key id. Never a secret; identifies which key was in play.

provider_api_base.description: The base URL the order request was actually sent to.

settlement_source.description: Derived from provider_environment by the collector: test|live -> provider, simulated -> simulator, unknown -> unattributed. The pairing is asserted in tests/test_provider_provenance.py rather than in schema conditionals, because this project's schema validator refuses keywords it cannot check (tests/_schema_validator.py) and conditionals would mean extending a validator to describe a derivation that code already guarantees.

provider_order_id.description: Provider order/reference id when the provider has a distinct order object; autonomous providers may leave this null.

provider_payment_id.description: Provider payment/authorization reference. This is generic; it may be a Razorpay payment id or another provider's payment reference.

webhook_event.description: Null until the first provider webhook arrives.

webhook_verified.description: A delivery arrived whose signature verified. Says nothing about which environment the sender belonged to; read settlement_source for that.

final_state.description: PROVIDER_AUTHORIZED = the provider holds an authorisation, money not captured. CAPTURED = the provider announced a capture, not yet corroborated by a direct read. PAID = capture confirmed by reconciliation as well as the webhook. PAYMENT_PENDING is the retired pre-Phase-9 spelling of PROVIDER_AUTHORIZED and remains listed only so historical artifacts still validate.

terminal.description: Derived by the collector from the canonical terminal set; never set independently
